4: The maxim stating that in “some say… and some say…" we rule according to the latter opinion is only when [Karo] says “There is someone who says … and the is someone [else] who says…"; but when he writes “These is someone who says… and S prohibits or permits [it]” – he may be implying that the latter opinion is an opinion of [only] one authority. Thus wrote the author of Kenesset HaGedolah, in his [book] Shiyarei [Kenesset HaGedolah], sec. 320, Comments on Beit Yosef, art. 7.
